intro.text: Raoden's mother, who defied Iadon to have their son healed in Elantris.
Raoden's mother, a woman of Kae with an unbending will and a boundless love for her son.

items.text: After a bad fall, Raoden's leg became infected. She and Iadon called in the best healers they could find, but none could stop the infection short of taking the leg. With few choices left, she went against Iadon's wishes and took Raoden into Elantris, and there an Elantrian healer cured the wound entirely.
She died two years before the Reod.

personality.text: Unbending in temperament, with a love for her son that nothing could shake.
